_comment: App Store metadata for /apps/<slug>/privacy/ and /apps/<slug>/support/. Apple requires both URLs per listing. An app whose support_contact is null, TODO, or an example.com address is SKIPPED by the generator with a build warning — a fabricated support address on a live listing is worse than a missing page. Set support_contact to a real monitored address to publish. Note: slug here is the STORE identity and is intentionally independent of the mission-control product slug, so a store rename does not require a registry rename.
